t: The Titan LED Work Light provides powerful and reliable illumination for diverse work environments. It is an essential tool for electricians, plumbers, and general builders requiring bright, consistent lighting on site, or for detailed home renovation tasks. Delivering 2000 lumens of crisp 6500K daylight, this 20W work lamp ensures excellent visibility for intricate work. Adjustable head allows precise light direction, while the wide handle aids easy transportation and positioning across the workspace. Built with a robust polycarbonate body and an IP65 rating, the unit offers durability and protection against dust and water ingress, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor jobs. 2.5m cable provides ample reach for various tasks.
